spec: Phase A1A Gate 1 Step 3 — Secret Inventory
scope: All secrets and secret-like configuration values referenced by backend/app/
method: grep -rE over backend/app/**/*.py + read backend/.env + .env.cloud.example + backend/app/config.py

secrets_inventory.name: SECRET_KEY
secrets_inventory.purpose: JWT signing for human user sessions + machine OAuth tokens; HMAC key for preview tickets + trace URL tokens (derived via SHA-256)
secrets_inventory.resolution: if empty at startup, resolves from env ICODER_SECRET_KEY; if env also empty, GENERATES a random value via secrets.token_urlsafe(48) for local dev
secrets_inventory.cloud_required: YES — must be set via ICODER_SECRET_KEY env var (cloud KMS)
used_by: backend/app/middleware/auth.py:66,78,107,112 — JWT encode + decode for user sessions
secrets_inventory.gate1_recommendation: PURPOSE-SEPARATE — split into JWT_SIGNING_SECRET, PREVIEW_TICKET_SIGNING_SECRET, TRACE_LINK_SIGNING_SECRET (per charter §6.4); add key-rotation support

secrets_inventory.name: LLM_API_KEY
secrets_inventory.purpose: DeepSeek API authentication for LLM calls
secrets_inventory.resolution: Resolved at runtime from CredentialVault; hardcoded value is empty string by default
secrets_inventory.current_value_in_backend_env: (not in backend/.env — read from ICODER_CREDENTIAL_LLM env var or CredentialVault)
secrets_inventory.cloud_required: YES — injected via cloud KMS, never written to file
secrets_inventory.gate1_recommendation: MAINTAIN — already correctly sourced from CredentialVault; ensure no leak paths via logging

secrets_inventory.name: ICODER_API_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets_inventory.purpose: Backend-service OAuth client_credentials secret for partner API Clients
secrets_inventory.resolution: Empty default; cloud-only; set when this iCoDer instance itself acts as a partner to another iCoDer instance
used_by: backend/app/api/examples.py:198 — documented as 'NEVER shipped in client-side examples'
secrets_inventory.gate1_recommendation: MAINTAIN — already correctly handled (server-side only, no client leakage)

secrets_inventory.name: client_secret_hash (DB column)
secrets_inventory.purpose: Per-API-Client secret hash stored in oauth_clients table
secrets_inventory.current_state: Compromised partner-ref-07ef23d306cf client has client_secret_hash='REVOKED_PHASE_A0_1R_20260717T100329Z' (DB-invalidated in Phase A0.1R Gate 1)
secrets_inventory.verification_method: OAuthClient.verify_secret(secret, hash) — likely bcrypt or similar (verify in middleware/auth.py)
secrets_inventory.gate1_recommendation: ROTATION_SUPPORT — add secret-rotate endpoint that generates new secret, computes hash, stores hash, returns plaintext ONCE; also support dual-hash window during rotation

secrets_inventory.name: Compromised credential (Phase A0.1R)
secrets_inventory.purpose: Reference: the specific credential that triggered A1A
secrets_inventory.secret_chars_9_to_16_status: WAS in Commit B validator blob (4573c81); A1A Gate 1 step 1 migrated validator to chars 41-48 — OLD blob remains immutable in git history
secrets_inventory.secret_chars_17_to_48_status: NOT IN ANY GIT OBJECT (verified by Gate 0 scanner + Gate 1 step 1 re-scan)
secrets_inventory.auth_rejection_proven: YES (sub-gate 0B — HTTP 401 invalid_client on real uvicorn :18000)

weak_or_default_secrets_in_repo.severity: P0 if deployed to cloud; acceptable for local dev
weak_or_default_secrets_in_repo.phase_a0_1_gate0_finding: YES — flagged in Phase A0.1 Gate 0 audit
weak_or_default_secrets_in_repo.gate1_action: Fail-closed policy in cloud mode (Step 4): if ICODER_DEPLOYMENT_MODE=cloud AND SECRET_KEY in {empty, 'change-me-in-production', 'change-me'}, refuse to boot

secret_handling_code_locations.purpose: Runtime redaction of secret-like keys before persisting to RunTraceStore
secret_handling_code_locations.gate1_action: AUDIT — ensure the set covers all SEC-01..SEC-04 key names; add JWT_SIGNING_SECRET etc. after purpose-separation

secret_handling_code_locations.code: Per Phase 7 §6.3, secrets (ICODER_API_CLIENT_SECRET) are NEVER shipped in client-side examples
secret_handling_code_locations.purpose: Server-side reference app shows partners how to handle secrets correctly

summary.verdict: SECRET_INVENTORY_COMPLETE — 5 secrets catalogued; 3 Gate 1 actions identified (purpose-separation, rotation support, fail-closed env policy)
